+"""RTL 环后端 —— AXI4-Lite 寄存器访问（/dev/mem mmap），作品核心链路。
+
+寄存器映射 = ``docs/design/interface.md`` v0.2（唯一契约）::
+
+    控制区: CTRL 0x00 | CMD 0x04 | TARGET_i 0x10+i*4 | TORQUE_LIM 0x30 | TIMING 0x34
+    状态区: STATUS 0x80 | FSM_STATE 0x84 | MEAS_i 0x90+i*4 | LOAD 0xB0+i*2(半字×8)
+            TEMP 0xD0 | ERR_BITMAP 0xE0 | TIMESTAMP 0xF0
+
+- 仅 Linux 板端可用（/dev/mem）；Windows 上 open() 会报错（PC 冒烟用 sim 后端）；
+- 角度 0.1° 定点编码细则属 interface.md 待定项 1，当前按
+  ``val = round(deg*10) & 0xFFF``（相对中位、无符号偏置待标定）占位——
+  定稿时本文件与 PL 侧同一批修订；
+- 控制环时序完全由 PL 内 grasp_fsm/servo_bus_ctrl 硬件保证，
+  本模块只做"写下发、读回读"，不参与实时调度（这正是对比实验的变量控制）。
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from typing import Iterable
+
+from app.control.servo_base import (
+    N_JOINTS,
+    FsmState,
+    FsmSnapshot,
+    GraspPlan,
+    ServoBackend,
+    ServoFeedback,
+)
+
+# ---- 寄存器偏移（interface.md v0.2） ----
+REG_CTRL = 0x00  # [0] enable [1] mode [2] estop
+REG_CMD = 0x04  # [7:0] cmd [15:8] arg；0x01 抓取 0x02 释放 0x03 预张 0x10 回中
+REG_TARGET0 = 0x10  # +i*4: [11:0] 角度0.1° [15:12] 舵机ID
+REG_TORQUE_LIM = 0x30  # 每 4 位一通道 0..15
+REG_TIMING = 0x34  # [7:0] 闭合速度 [15:8] 轮询周期(×0.1ms)
+REG_STATUS = 0x80  # [0] busy [1] grasped [2] timeout [3] fault
+REG_FSM_STATE = 0x84
+REG_MEAS0 = 0x90  # +i*4: [11:0] 角度 [15:12] 标志
+REG_LOAD0 = 0xB0  # +i*2: 16 位半字 ×8（跨 32 位字对齐）
+REG_TEMP = 0xD0
+REG_ERR_BITMAP = 0xE0
+REG_TIMESTAMP = 0xF0
+
+DEFAULT_AXI_BASE = 0x4000_0000
+_PAGE_SIZE = 4096
+
+
+class AxilRegs:
+    """AXI4-Lite 从接口的 /dev/mem 访问器（32bit 读写）。"""
+
+    def __init__(self, base_addr: int = DEFAULT_AXI_BASE):
+        self._base = base_addr
+        self._map = None
+        self._fd = None
+
+    def open(self) -> None:
+        import mmap
+        import os
+
+        self._fd = os.open("/dev/mem", os.O_RDWR | os.O_SYNC)
+        page = self._base & ~(_PAGE_SIZE - 1)
+        offset = self._base - page
+        self._map = mmap.mmap(self._fd, _PAGE_SIZE, mmap.MAP_SHARED,
+                              mmap.PROT_READ | mmap.PROT_WRITE, offset=offset)
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        if self._map is not None:
+            self._map.close()
+            self._map = None
+        if self._fd is not None:
+            import os
+
+            os.close(self._fd)
+            self._fd = None
+
+    def read32(self, offset: int) -> int:
+        assert self._map is not None, "call open() first"
+        return int.from_bytes(self._map[offset:offset + 4], "little")
+
+    def write32(self, offset: int, value: int) -> None:
+        assert self._map is not None, "call open() first"
+        self._map[offset:offset + 4] = int(value & 0xFFFF_FFFF).to_bytes(4, "little")
+
+    def read16(self, offset: int) -> int:
+        """半字读：LOAD 区 0xB0+i*2 跨 32 位字，按对齐字读取后截取。"""
+        word_off = offset & ~0x3
+        shift = (offset - word_off) * 8
+        return (self.read32(word_off) >> shift) & 0xFFFF
+
+
+def enc_target(servo_id: int, angle_deg: float) -> int:
+    """TARGET_i 编码：[15:12] ID + [11:0] 角度 0.1°（编码细则=待定项 1，占位）。"""
+    deci = int(round(angle_deg * 10)) & 0xFFF
+    return ((servo_id & 0xF) << 12) | deci
+
+
+def dec_meas(word: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """MEAS_i 解码 → (位置 0.1°, 标志)。"""
+    return word & 0xFFF, (word >> 12) & 0xF
+
+
+class FpgaBackend(ServoBackend):
+    name = "fpga"
+
+    def __init__(self, axi_base: int = DEFAULT_AXI_BASE,
+                 servo_ids: Iterable[int] = range(1, 9),
+                 poll_period_units: int = 10):  # 10×0.1ms = 1kHz（interface.md §6）
+        self._regs = AxilRegs(axi_base)
+        self._ids = tuple(servo_ids)
+        self._poll_units = poll_period_units
+
+    def open(self) -> None:
+        self._regs.open()
+        # TIMING：轮询周期 1kHz 默认；闭合速度由 GraspPlan 逐次下发
+        self._regs.write32(REG_TIMING, (self._poll_units & 0xFF) << 8)
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        self.emergency_stop()
+        self._regs.close()
+
+    # -- ServoBackend 接口 ----------------------------------------------
+
+    def set_torque(self, on: bool) -> None:
+        # CMD=0x04 力矩使能（arg 1=使能 0=断开）——interface.md §3 CMD 扩展，v0.2.1 起生效
+        self._regs.write32(REG_CMD, ((0x01 if on else 0x00) << 8) | 0x04)
+
+    def set_targets(self, angles_deg: tuple[float, ...], speed_raw: int = 0) -> None:
+        # 直接角度模式：CTRL.mode=0
+        ctrl = self._regs.read32(REG_CTRL)
+        self._regs.write32(REG_CTRL, (ctrl & ~0x2) | 0x1)
+        for i, sid in enumerate(self._ids):
+            self._regs.write32(REG_TARGET0 + i * 4, enc_target(sid, angles_deg[i]))
+        self._regs.write32(REG_TIMING, ((self._poll_units & 0xFF) << 8) | (speed_raw & 0xFF))
+
+    def start_grasp_fsm(self, plan: GraspPlan) -> None:
+        # 状态机模式：写目标/力矩/时序 → CTRL.mode=1 → CMD=0x01
+        for i, sid in enumerate(self._ids):
+            self._regs.write32(REG_TARGET0 + i * 4, enc_target(sid, plan.angles_deg[i]))
+        torque_word = 0
+        for i in range(N_JOINTS):
+            torque_word |= (plan.torque_levels[i] & 0xF) << (4 * i)
+        self._regs.write32(REG_TORQUE_LIM, torque_word)
+        self._regs.write32(REG_TIMING,
+                           ((self._poll_units & 0xFF) << 8) | (plan.speed_raw & 0xFF))
+        ctrl = self._regs.read32(REG_CTRL)
+        self._regs.write32(REG_CTRL, ctrl | 0x2 | 0x1)  # mode=1, enable=1
+        self._regs.write32(REG_CMD, 0x01)
+
+    def release(self) -> None:
+        self._regs.write32(REG_CMD, 0x02)
+
+    def emergency_stop(self) -> None:
+        ctrl = self._regs.read32(REG_CTRL)
+        self._regs.write32(REG_CTRL, ctrl | 0x4)  # estop=1
+
+    def poll_fsm(self) -> FsmSnapshot:
+        status = self._regs.read32(REG_STATUS)
+        feedback = self._read_feedback()
+        return FsmSnapshot(
+            state=FsmState(self._regs.read32(REG_FSM_STATE) & 0xFF),
+            busy=bool(status & 0x1),
+            grasped=bool(status & 0x2),
+            timeout=bool(status & 0x4),
+            fault=bool(status & 0x8),
+            err_bitmap=self._regs.read32(REG_ERR_BITMAP),
+            loop_timestamp=self._regs.read32(REG_TIMESTAMP),
+            feedback=feedback,
+        )
+
+    def read_loop_timestamp(self) -> int:
+        return self._regs.read32(REG_TIMESTAMP)
+
+    def _read_feedback(self) -> list[ServoFeedback]:
+        temp_word = self._regs.read32(REG_TEMP)
+        feedback: list[ServoFeedback] = []

+"""主状态机 —— 待命 → 识别 → 引导 → 抓取 → 保持 → 释放（architecture.md 数据流落地）。

+无硬件阶段运行方式（PC，backend=sim，全部 mock 输入）::
+
+    python host/app/main.py --mock-voice "抓起香蕉,放下"
+

+
+    python host/app/main.py            # 读 settings.yaml，voice/vision 模块接入后生效
+
+设计要点：
+- 依赖全部经构造注入（``Deps``）：voice/vision 用 :class:`VoiceSource` /
+  :class:`VisionSource` 协议抽象，正式模块（kws.py / detector.py）落地后替换

+- ``run()`` 显式 tick 驱动、返回状态历史——确定性可测（冒烟断言状态序列）；

+# ------------------------------------------------------------------
+# 数据契约
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class AppState(str, Enum):
+    IDLE = "IDLE"
+    RECOGNIZING = "RECOGNIZING"
+    GUIDING = "GUIDING"
+    GRASPING = "GRASPING"
+    HOLDING = "HOLDING"
+    RELEASING = "RELEASING"
+    FAULT = "FAULT"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Command:
+    """语音模块输出：结构化指令（project_framework F1）。"""
+
+    action: str  # grasp / release / stop / reset
+    target: str = ""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Detection:
+    """视觉模块输出：目标物体（F2）。"""
+
+    category: str
+    size_mm: tuple[float, float, float]
+    yaw_deg: float = 0.0
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class GuideResult:
+    """ArUco 就位引导输出（F2c）：偏移与就位判定。"""
+
+    in_position: bool
+    dx_cm: float = 0.0
+    dy_cm: float = 0.0
+    dyaw_deg: float = 0.0
+
+
+class VoiceSource(Protocol):
+    def poll_command(self) -> Command | None: ...
+
+
+class VisionSource(Protocol):
+    def detect_target(self) -> Detection | None: ...
+    def guide_hand(self) -> GuideResult: ...

+

+class Deps:
+    backend: ServoBackend
+    voice: VoiceSource
+    vision: VisionSource
+    selector: GraspSelector
+    tick_s: float = 0.01
+    recognize_timeout_s: float = 5.0
+    guide_timeout_s: float = 30.0

+# ------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Mock 实现（PC 冒烟；正式模块落地后整体替换）

+
+class MockVoice:
+    """脚本化命令队列：按 tick 节拍逐个吐出。"""
+
+    def __init__(self, commands: list[Command], interval_ticks: int = 10):
+        self._queue = list(commands)
+        self._interval = interval_ticks
+        self._countdown = 0
+
+    def poll_command(self) -> Command | None:
+        if self._countdown > 0 or not self._queue:

+# 主状态机

+def run(deps: Deps, max_ticks: int = 100_000) -> list[str]:

+    history: list[str] = [AppState.IDLE.value]
+    state = AppState.IDLE

+    for _ in range(max_ticks):

+        if state == AppState.IDLE:
+            cmd = deps.voice.poll_command()
+            if cmd is None:
+                continue
+            if cmd.action == "grasp":
+                target = cmd.target
+                goto(AppState.RECOGNIZING, f"voice: grasp {target}")
+            elif cmd.action == "stop":

+            elif cmd.action == "reset":

+        elif state == AppState.RECOGNIZING:

+        elif state == AppState.GUIDING:
+            if state_t > deps.guide_timeout_s:
+                goto(AppState.IDLE, "guide timeout")
+                continue
+            guide = deps.vision.guide_hand()
+            if guide.in_position:
+                assert plan is not None
+                deps.backend.start_grasp_fsm(plan)

+                    deps.log(

+        elif state == AppState.GRASPING:

+                goto(AppState.FAULT, "voice: stop")

+2. ``sim/verify_grasp.py`` MuJoCo 离线验证后回填（source=mujoco）；

+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from app.control.servo_base import GraspPlan
+
+# 表文件位置：随包分发，亦可被 settings.yaml 覆盖
+DEFAULT_TABLE = Path(__file__).with_name("grasp_table.json")
+
+
+class GraspSelector:
+    def __init__(self, table_path: Path | str = DEFAULT_TABLE):
+        self._raw = json.loads(Path(table_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        self._default = self._raw["default"]
+        self._objects: dict[str, dict] = self._raw.get("objects", {})
+
+    @property
+    def known_objects(self) -> list[str]:
+        return sorted(self._objects)
+
+    def select(self, category: str, size_mm: tuple[float, float, float] | None = None,
+               yaw_deg: float | None = None) -> GraspPlan:
+        """查表生成抓取计划；未收录类别回退 default（调用方需提示）。"""
+        entry = self._objects.get(category, self._default)
+        torque = list(entry["torque_levels"])
+        if size_mm is not None:
+            longest = max(size_mm)
+            if longest > 120:  # 大物体：整体降 1 级防过载（骨架版粗调）
+                torque = [max(1, t - 1) for t in torque]
+        return GraspPlan(
+            angles_deg=tuple(entry["angles_deg"]),
+            pregrasp_deg=tuple(entry["pregrasp_deg"]),
+            speed_raw=int(entry["speed_raw"]),
+            torque_levels=tuple(torque),
+            mode=entry["mode"],
+            label=category if category in self._objects else f"{category}(fallback)",
+        )

+"""第 2 步冒烟测试 —— 三后端契约 + 抓取策略 + 主状态机全链路空转。
+
+运行::
+
+    python host/tests/smoke_test_backend.py
+
+覆盖：
+1. ServoBackend 契约（backend_sim）：目标下发→反馈收敛、力控抓取全周期、
+   超时保持语义、急停保护
+2. GraspSelector：查表、fallback、尺寸降级
+3. main.run：mock 语音/视觉注入下的完整状态序列（IDLE→…→HOLDING→…→IDLE）
+   与故障路径（stop→FAULT→reset→IDLE）
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))  # host/
+
+from app.control.backend_sim import SimBackend  # noqa: E402
+from app.control.servo_base import FsmState, GraspPlan  # noqa: E402
+from app.main import AppState, Deps, MockVision, MockVoice, Command, run  # noqa: E402
+from app.strategy.grasp_selector import GraspSelector  # noqa: E402
+
+MIDDLE = (0.0,) * 8
+
+
+def _plan(angles=(90, 0, 90, 0, 90, 0, 90, 0), torque=(6,) * 8) -> GraspPlan:
+    return GraspPlan(angles_deg=angles, pregrasp_deg=(-35, 35) * 4,
+                     speed_raw=3, torque_levels=torque, label="test")
+
+
+def _sim_backend() -> SimBackend:
+    return SimBackend(middle_deg=MIDDLE)
+
+
+# ==========================================================================
+# 1. 后端契约
+# ==========================================================================
+
+
+def test_targets_drive_feedback() -> None:
+    b = _sim_backend()
+    b.open()
+    try:
+        b.set_torque(True)
+        b.set_targets((60, -30, 60, -30, 60, -30, 60, -30), speed_raw=0)
+        for _ in range(200):
+            b.tick(0.05)  # 10s，全速足够到位
+        fb = b.poll_fsm().feedback
+        assert all(abs(f.position_deg - a) <= 1.0
+                   for f, a in zip(fb, (60, -30, 60, -30, 60, -30, 60, -30))), \
+            f"positions not converged: {[round(f.position_deg, 1) for f in fb]}"
+    finally:
+        b.close()
+
+
+def test_fsm_full_cycle_grasp_and_release() -> None:
+    """PREGRASP→CLOSING→(力阈值)HOLD→RELEASING→IDLE 全周期。"""
+    b = _sim_backend()
+    b.open()
+    try:
+        # 手指闭合路径上放"物体"：负载超过力矩阈值(6级→384raw)
+        load = {sid: 500 for sid in b.bus.servo_ids}
+        b.bus.inject_external_load(load)
+        b.start_grasp_fsm(_plan())
+        assert b.poll_fsm().state == FsmState.PREGRASP
+        for _ in range(60):  # 0.6s：PREGRASP(0.3s) + CLOSING 首拍即达阈值
+            b.tick(0.01)
+        snap = b.poll_fsm()
+        assert snap.state == FsmState.HOLD
+        assert snap.grasped and not snap.timeout
+        b.release()
+        for _ in range(80):  # 0.8s > RELEASING 0.5s
+            b.tick(0.01)
+        assert b.poll_fsm().state == FsmState.IDLE
+    finally:
+        b.close()
+
+
+def test_fsm_closing_timeout_semantics() -> None:
+    """无物体闭合到底？——速度受限 3s 内未到位/未触力阈值 → HOLD 且 timeout=True。"""
+    b = _sim_backend()
+    b.open()
+    try:
+        b.start_grasp_fsm(_plan())  # 无负载；speed_raw=3 → 3s 内走不到 90°
+        for _ in range(400):  # 4s > PREGRASP 0.3 + CLOSING 3.0
+            b.tick(0.01)
+        snap = b.poll_fsm()
+        assert snap.state == FsmState.HOLD
+        assert snap.timeout and not snap.grasped, \
+            "timeout hold must not be reported as grasped"
+    finally:
+        b.close()
+
+
+def test_emergency_stop_protects() -> None:
+    b = _sim_backend()
+    b.open()
+    try:
+        b.start_grasp_fsm(_plan())
+        b.emergency_stop()
+        snap = b.poll_fsm()
+        assert snap.state == FsmState.PROTECT and snap.fault
+        assert all(not s.torque_on for s in
+                   (b.bus.state(i) for i in b.bus.servo_ids)), "estop must cut torque"
+    finally:
+        b.close()
+
+
+def test_drop_fault_during_hold_goes_protect() -> None:
+    """保持阶段掉线 → PROTECT（力控安全路径）。"""
+    b = _sim_backend()
+    b.open()
+    try:
+        b.bus.inject_external_load({sid: 500 for sid in b.bus.servo_ids})
+        b.start_grasp_fsm(_plan())
+        for _ in range(80):
+            b.tick(0.01)
+        assert b.poll_fsm().state == FsmState.HOLD
+        b.bus.inject_drop([5])  # 无名指舵机掉线
+        b.tick(0.01)
+        assert b.poll_fsm().state == FsmState.PROTECT
+    finally:
+        b.close()
+
+
+# ==========================================================================
+# 2. 抓取策略
+# ==========================================================================
+
+
+def test_selector_known_object() -> None:
+    sel = GraspSelector()
+    plan = sel.select("banana", size_mm=(180.0, 40.0, 40.0))
+    assert plan.label == "banana"
+    assert len(plan.angles_deg) == 8 and len(plan.torque_levels) == 8
+    assert plan.mode == "power"
+
+
+def test_selector_fallback_and_size_derating() -> None:
+    sel = GraspSelector()
+    plan = sel.select("unknown_thing")
+    assert "fallback" in plan.label
+    big = sel.select("apple", size_mm=(150.0, 150.0, 150.0))
+    base = sel.select("apple")
+    assert all(b <= a - 1 for b, a in zip(big.torque_levels, base.torque_levels)), \
+        "large objects must derate torque"
+
+
+# ==========================================================================
+# 3. 主状态机全链路（mock 注入）
+# ==========================================================================
+
+
+def _deps(backend: SimBackend, voice: MockVoice, vision: MockVision) -> Deps:
+    logs: list[str] = []
+    return Deps(backend=backend, voice=voice, vision=vision,
+                selector=GraspSelector(), tick_s=0.01,
+                log=logs.append), logs
+
+
+def test_main_pipeline_full_cycle() -> None:
+    """语音'抓起香蕉'→识别→引导→抓取→保持；'放下'→释放→待命。"""
+    b = _sim_backend()
+    b.open()
+    try:
+        b.bus.inject_external_load({sid: 500 for sid in b.bus.servo_ids})
+        voice = MockVoice([Command("grasp", "banana"), Command("release")], interval_ticks=10)
+        deps, logs = _deps(b, voice, MockVision("banana", delay_ticks=20))
+        history = run(deps, max_ticks=5000)
+        text = " ".join(history)
+        assert "RECOGNIZING" in text and "GUIDING" in text
+        assert "GRASPING" in text and "HOLDING" in text
+        assert "RELEASING" in text
+        assert text.strip().endswith("IDLE") or history[-1].startswith("IDLE"), history
+        assert any("plan=banana" in line for line in logs), "selector must be consulted"
+    finally:
+        b.close()
+
+
+def test_main_stop_and_reset_path() -> None:
+    """stop→FAULT→reset→IDLE 故障恢复路径。"""
+    b = _sim_backend()
+    b.open()
+    try:
+        voice = MockVoice([Command("stop"), Command("reset")], interval_ticks=5)
+        deps, _ = _deps(b, voice, MockVision(delay_ticks=1))
+        history = run(deps, max_ticks=2000)
+        text = " ".join(history)
+        assert "FAULT" in text
+        assert history[-1].startswith("IDLE"), history
+        assert all(not s.torque_on for s in
+                   (b.bus.state(i) for i in b.bus.servo_ids)) or \
+            b.bus.state(1).torque_on, "reset path re-enables torque"
+    finally:
+        b.close()
+
+
+def test_main_recognize_timeout_returns_idle() -> None:
+    """识别超时回 IDLE（视觉无目标场景）。"""
+
+    class BlindVision:
+        def detect_target(self):  # noqa: ANN202
+            return None
+
+        def guide_hand(self):  # noqa: ANN202
+            raise AssertionError("should not reach guiding")
+
+    b = _sim_backend()
+    b.open()
+    try:
+        voice = MockVoice([Command("grasp", "banana")], interval_ticks=5)
+        deps, _ = _deps(b, voice, BlindVision())
+        deps.recognize_timeout_s = 0.2
+        history = run(deps, max_ticks=500)
+        assert history[-1].startswith("IDLE"), history
+        assert "RECOGNIZING" in " ".join(history)
+    finally:
+        b.close()
+
+
+# ==========================================================================
+# 入口
+# ==========================================================================
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    tests = [
+        (name, fn)
+        for name, fn in sorted(globals().items())
+        if name.startswith("test_") and callable(fn)
+    ]
+    failures = 0
+    for name, fn in tests:
+        try:
+            fn()
+            print(f"  PASS  {name}")
+        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
+            failures += 1
+            print(f"  FAIL  {name}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
+    total = len(tests)
+    print(f"\n{total - failures}/{total} passed")
+    return 1 if failures else 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
